name: E2E: Requestor creates an incident through conversational interaction
objective: Validate the complete end-to-end journey where a user describes an issue conversationally, the assistant classifies it as an Incident, gathers details, creates the ticket after confirmation, and verifies source tracking, categorization, and routing.
precondition: User has valid credentials. Routing rules and category mappings are configured.

steps.description: Log in to the self-service portal and navigate to home page
steps.expectedResult: Home page loads with Agentforce icon visible

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon to open the AI Assistant
Describe the issue in natural language
steps.testData: "My email application has been crashing every time I open it since this morning"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies the intent as a system failure

steps.description: Verify the assistant classifies the request as an Incident

steps.testData: "It affects Outlook on my Windows laptop, error code 0x800CCC0E"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant maintains context and gathers all required information

steps.description: Verify the assistant presents a summary for review
steps.expectedResult: Summary displayed with description, category, and classification

steps.description: Verify incident number and link are displayed
steps.expectedResult: Incident number (INC-XXXXX) and clickable link are shown

steps.description: Open the created ticket and verify Source = Agentforce, Channel = Portal
Verify Short Description and Description are generated from conversation
steps.expectedResult: Fields contain AI-generated content from the conversation

steps.description: Verify Category and Subcategory are populated
steps.expectedResult: Category and Subcategory are auto-populated based on AI classification

steps.description: Verify the ticket is routed to the appropriate resolver queue
steps.expectedResult: Assignment Group corresponds to the correct resolver queue
